answer_1.quote: The predominant utilization of GANs in NLP has been confined to text generation tasks, including summarization, poetry generation, dialog systems, and machine translation.
answer_1.outputs: SLGAN generates tag sequences for sequence labeling tasks such as word segmentation, named entity recognition, and part-of-speech tagging.

answer_2.quote: Beyond the conventional Micro F1 score, we recognize the significance of the Out-of-Vocabulary (OOV) error as a crucial metric for assessing a word segmentation model's generalization capacity. Consequently, we introduce OOV recall (R_oov) to evaluate the generalization ability of SLGAN in the WS task.
